name: Oaxaca Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid highlands of southern mexico (central oaxaca)
description: Very local and endemic to interior of Oaxaca, where replaces larger and bulkier Rusty Sparrow (no known range overlap). Favors brushy woodland and edge and oak thickets with adjacent grassy areas.

name: New Caledonian Friarbird
rangeDescription: Forest of new caledonia, including maré and lifou (loyalty islands)
description: Large, vociferous honeyeater with a long, heavy bill. Typical friarbird plumage, mostly brown with grayer wings and tail, and paler plume-like feathers on the chest.

name: Lesser Wagtail-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Along larger rivers of western and central amazonia from eastern ecuador (napo river) and eastern peru (río napo, río ucayali, and amazon river) eastward to central brazil (to the lower río tapajós); also a population (possibly an undescribed taxon) in río orinoco drainages in far eastern colombia (vichada) and southwestern venezuela (western amazonas)
description: Small, slender, and long-tailed bird found only on islands along major rivers in the Amazon basin. Distinctive in its specialized habitat with yellow underparts and eyebrow, and conspicuous white patches in its wings and tail.

name: Prairie Falcon
rangeDescription: Arid north america (british columbia to northern mexico)
description: Large, brown-and-white falcon of dry, open areas in western North America. Pale brown above and white below, with dark streaks and prominent mustache.

name: Hooded Parrot
rangeDescription: Northern australia (northeastern northern territory)
description: A slender and long-tailed parrot restricted to a relatively small range in the Northern Territory, where it inhabits open woodlands. Male a striking turquoise color with black cap, yellow wings, rosy undertail coverts, and olive back.

name: Babar Whistler
rangeDescription: Babar (eastern lesser sundas)
description: A chunky, heavy-billed forest songbird endemic to the island of Babar, located in eastern Indonesia between Timor and the Tanimbar Islands. Male is distinctive, with a black hood, a white throat, bright yellow underside, and dull green upperparts with a golden collar.

name: North Island Robin
rangeDescription: North, little barrier, and kapiti islands (new zealand)
description: A small charcoal-colored songbird endemic to New Zealand. Confined to central North Island and a few offshore predator-free islands.

name: Biak Whistler
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: Medium-sized bird of forest on Biak Island. Warm brown above, paler below, orange-brown face and rufous flight feathers.

name: Philby's Partridge
rangeDescription: Rocky desert of southwestern saudi arabia and northern yemen
description: Handsome partridge of the southwest Arabian mountains. Mostly pale gray and tan, with chestnut-and-white slashes along the sides, and a black face mask.

name: Garden Emerald
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica and panama; coiba and pearl islands
description: Small hummingbird with limited range. Male entirely glittering green with dark forked tail.

name: Leaf Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Flores (lesser sundas)
description: A long-tailed, red-billed parrot, mostly lime-green apart from a paler collar, a marginally darker head, and a yellow-green patch on the breast. In flight, shows yellow underwings.

name: Stripe-breasted Wren
rangeDescription: Caribbean lowlands of eastern nicaragua to western panama
description: Medium-sized wren, brown above with bold black-and-white streaking on face and breast. Distinctive in range.

name: Atlantic Royal Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (minas gerais, rio de janeiro, são paulo, and paraná)
description: Endemic to southeastern Brazil. Uncommon, medium-sized, overall brown flycatcher of humid tropical forest in lowlands.

name: Elfin-woods Warbler
rangeDescription: Montane elfin forest of west-central and northeastern puerto rico
description: A medium-sized warbler of moist montane dwarf forests where it feeds actively in dense canopy foliage. It is most readily distinguished from Black-and-white Warbler by the absence of white streaking on its back and the lack of a white eyebrow.

name: Togo Paradise-Whydah
rangeDescription: Sierra leone to ivory coast, ghana, and togo; cameroon
description: A nest parasite that lays its eggs in the nests of Yellow-winged Pytilias. As with other whydahs, breeding males are spectacular and bizarre, whereas non-breeding males and females are drab and inconspicuous.

name: Buff-breasted Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Breeds high arctic dry coastal tundra of far northeastern palearctic and northern nearctic, from northern chukotka eastward from wrangel island (off northeastern siberia), alaskan north slope from pt. barrow eastward through northeastern canada, including arctic islands from banks to devon islands (northeastern canada); migrates to coastal and inland grassland of subtropical southern neotropics, mainly in southeastern brazil and uruguay to central argentina; prone to extreme vagrancy worldwide
description: Elegant buffy sandpiper; peaceful-looking with large eye and plain face. Relatively short bill and medium-length yellow legs.

name: Blue-bellied Parrot
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southeastern brazil (southern bahia to rio grande do sul)
description: Fairly large parrot with a long tail and a pale bill. Mostly green with a blue tail tip and bluish underwings.

name: Brown-backed Parrotlet
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia to rio de janeiro and são paulo)
description: Small parrot with a short, squared tail that has red outer tail feathers with a black band across the tips. Mostly green with a brown patch on the back and pale gray flanks.

name: Diamond Firetail
rangeDescription: Southeastern australia (east-central queensland to southern victoria and southeastern south australia)
description: Plump, tiny bird with olive back, gray head, white belly and throat, white-spotted black flanks, black breast band, and bright red bill in adult. In flight, bright red rump apparent.

name: Tibetan Snowfinch
rangeDescription: Eastern tibetan plateau (northeastern xizang, qinghai)
description: Small brown finch of open highland steppes on the Tibetan plateau. Male has short but prominent black mustache and a dark bill.
